scenes.name: Live Studio Overview & Hybrid Architecture
scenes.subtitle: Welcome to Sentinel-AI, live on GitHub Pages at genda-benjamin.github.io/sentinel-hybrid-ai. Offline-first on-device AI pairing Gemini Nano 4 with Gemini 2.5 Pro.
scenes.text: Welcome to Sentinel-AI, the offline-first hybrid AI security auditor for Google BuildHybridAI 2026. On our live production deployment, we show real-time on-device AST analysis and self-healing patch generation. Notice our live telemetry badges: active zero-leakage airgap, Gemini Nano readiness, and cryptographically verified Firebase App Check attestation.

scenes.name: Custom Code Input & Zero-Leakage AST Edge Vault
scenes.topic: 🔐 DYNAMIC AST EDGE VAULTING (ZERO PLAINTEXT ESCAPE)
scenes.subtitle: Typing arbitrary code with secrets triggers sub-millisecond AST redaction into [VAULT_TOKEN_001] before any egress.
scenes.text: To prove the live studio is truly dynamic, we select Custom User Code and type production code with a database secret. Instantly, our on-device AST engine tokenizes the password into vault token zero-zero-one in sub-millisecond latency. Zero plaintext bytes escape to the cloud, satisfying SOC 2 and GDPR Article 32.

scenes.name: On-Device Gemini Nano 4 Reasoning & Sub-15ms Latency
scenes.subtitle: Standard vulnerabilities execute 100% on-device in under 15ms at zero cloud compute cost.
scenes.text: Next, we click Run Hybrid AI Audit. As a standard SQL injection vulnerability, Sentinel-AI routes execution on-device to Gemini Nano 4. With local NPU acceleration, triage completes in under fifteen milliseconds at zero compute cost with a complete airgap guarantee.

scenes.name: Self-Healing Unified Diff & Verifiable Invariant Tests
scenes.subtitle: Synthesizes standard diff --git parameterized patches and executable node:test mathematical proofs.
scenes.text: The engine dynamically synthesizes a Git unified diff replacing string concatenation with safe parameterized queries. Clicking the Regression Test tab reveals an auto-generated executable node:test suite proving the exploit payload is rejected while benign inputs pass.

scenes.name: Multi-Hop Cross-File Taint Flow & Cloud Escalation
scenes.topic: 🧠 CLOUD ESCALATION TO GEMINI 2.5 PRO & TAINT GRAPH
scenes.subtitle: Cross-service call graphs escalate to Gemini 2.5 Pro with verified App Check attestation.
scenes.text: Selecting the Multi-File Taint Graph preset, Sentinel-AI detects cross-service dependencies and escalates to Gemini 2.5 Pro via Firebase AI Logic with App Check attestation. Scrolling down reveals the interactive four-stage taint graph tracing the flow from source to sink.

scenes.name: OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 Export & Hackathon Conclusion
scenes.subtitle: 88/88 Passing Tests (100% Green) • Live at genda-benjamin.github.io/sentinel-hybrid-ai
scenes.text: Sentinel-AI exports compliant OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 reports and formal SOC 2 compliance summaries. With eighty-eight passing tests, one hundred percent green coverage, and Apache 2.0 open-source licensing, Sentinel-AI is enterprise ready.
